issues.body: mergeNTriples still deduplicates exact lines across independently returned N-Triples documents and asserts that the same blank-node label across runs identifies the same node. RDF blank-node labels are scoped to their result/document, and CONSTRUCT template blank nodes may be freshly allocated for each solution and execution. Two expansions can therefore both serialize unrelated nodes as _:b0; merging unchanged labels conflates them and exact-line deduplication may erase a distinct triple. This is the same major correctness issue reported in round 5.
issues.fix_hint: Alpha-rename blank nodes with a unique namespace per result document before union so independently generated nodes cannot collide. If stable store blank-node identity must survive across queries, use an explicit engine-provided stable identity or skolemization rather than result-local labels. Add a test merging two documents that both contain _:b0 with different structures and assert they remain distinct, plus coverage for the intended persistent-store blank-node policy.
issues.title: Independent expansion results still conflate blank nodes

verdict.summary: Round 6 is stagnant: the round 5 blank-node identity defect remains unchanged. mergeNTriples still unions independently returned graph documents by exact serialized line while assuming matching blank-node labels denote the same node. Since blank-node labels are scoped to an RDF result/document and CONSTRUCT may allocate fresh template blank nodes per execution, accumulated lens expansions can silently conflate distinct nodes or discard distinct triples. The added tests still cover only ground IRI triples and do not exercise cross-document blank-node collisions.
